content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I am looking forward to working together, but I would like to request a couple of adjustments before signing. - Regarding the clause stating "Invoices are payable Net 40. An invoice that remains unpaid after the due date may accrue interest at 1.0% per month to the extent permitted by applicable law.", payment is due in 40 days, which is longer than the standard 30-day term and creates a cash flow delay for you. I propose changing this so that invoices are payable Net 30 instead. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
